0022600127.text: The Warriors (0-3, 14th in the West) are 0-2 on the road and on a three-game losing streak as they visit the Nuggets (1-1, 7th in the West), who are 1-0 at home and riding a one-game win streak. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors lost 116-93 in their last meeting, in Denver on March 29, 2026.
